topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: The dim light of dusk didn’t lessen the gleam of the new car parked discreetly in my neighbor’s garage, barely visible through the half-closed door. I couldn’t shake the image of it, a whisper of luxury that seemed out of place. It’s strange how a small detail can unsettle the routine of days, the quiet trust in the familiar. I found myself peering through the curtains more often, as if the shadows of his backyard held secrets. The rustling of the trees at night echoed with questions I didn’t dare voice. What lies behind the closed doors, beyond the reach of sunlight? The comfort of my small, orderly life seemed narrower, the walls a bit closer.
